Tasks And Responsibilities

• Conduct Maintenance work in accordance with work management procedures and job plans

• Contribute to the development or improvement of procedures as required to execute work in a safe, efficient and timely manner.

• Provide knowledge of procedures to enable resource teams to successfully complete their work in their area

• Ensure that the product / service provided meets the customer schedule / order / agreement requirements.

• Identify, report and initiate (or recommend) possible solutions to problems in processes or systems.

• Initiate actions to prevent occurrences of any non-conformances relating to the process or systems through the Continuous Improvement System.

• Actively participate in the continuous improvement process.

 Requirements

• Minimum experience as a Fire Tester for 3-5 years.

AQF Certificate III including at least two years of on-the-job training, or AQF Certificate IV

 Benefits

 Employer sponsored visa
